predicate.label: athlete plays for team
predicate.definition: Person X plays or played as an athlete for sports team Y.
includes: playing for or with the team as athlete
excludes: team leading or beating another team
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: player/center/guard/wing/captain/scorer role on a team; playing for or with the team as athlete; scoring for the team. Excludes: coach/manager/owner alone; team leading or beating another team; generic lead without athlete context; reverse team-to-athlete direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: bare lead without player/position/scoring context.

rationale: Player/center/scorer and playing/scoring-for paths identify the dominant athlete-to-team family. Bare lead must be resolved from case-local athlete context; coaches and institutional leaders remain separate.
